about: Retrieval-quality set for the personal companion (bench/personal_eval.py). Corpus = the 15 story utterances in backend/companion/story.py (run through the real agent) plus `extra_notes`. A query is a hit at k if any returned memory's text contains one of its `relevant` substrings. Queries are written as paraphrases (little word overlap with the memory) on purpose. First-draft labels by the author; a second person has not labelled them.
